name: Shaped inventory packing
oneLiner: A grid bag where every item takes its real shape (1x1 potions, 1x3 staves, a 5-cell axe, L, T, S and plus pieces). The player drags items with mouse or touch, or carries them with keys, and turns them a quarter turn (a real rotation; squares and plus shapes never turn). Where an item would land shows green (free), blue (stacks), amber (swaps: the item you get stays visible, outlined and labelled) or red (blocked, with the blockers glowing). Auto-sort packs largest first and never loses an item. Stacks show counts, a tooltip sits where it covers the fewest items, and a ground tray holds loot and drops. Use and Drop go through the game's callbacks; quest items refuse to drop. Phones get one grid at a time with tabs and the tooltip as a strip. Every item is a panel that follows its footprint exactly with its icon upright on the largest block (the game's own icons or sprites, else a bold glyph), in a 16-bit pixel look or an HD look.
fits: action RPGs and dungeon crawlers with loot
survival and extraction games where space is the limit
roguelites with a backpack of relics
top-down adventures with a bag screen
notFor: games with a plain list or slot inventory where shape and space do not matter (use G-01 shop & inventory grid)
real-time games that cannot pause while the bag is open
inventories of hundreds of item kinds that are browsed rather than packed

needs: an item table: id -> name, shape, stack size, kind, description (optional own image)
the moment the bag opens (a key, a loot chest, a full pickup) in update logic, and loot to show on the ground
keys while open (arrows / WASD, Z, X, R, T, U, G, F) and pointer events in native canvas px
a fixed update step while open; the game pauses its world while busy()
callbacks: onUse (apply the effect or refuse), onDrop (refuse quest items), onClose (what stays on the ground)
provides: the bag: count, add, remove, canAdd, sync, serialize / restore, onChange per count change
a modal bag window drawn last: two grids, ghost feedback, tooltip, stack counts, buttons, footer message
auto-sort and take-all that never lose an item
state(), entries(), events(), lastDrawn() and rect() for judges and other overlays

params.label: Phone layout (one grid at a time)

assets: module/shaped-inventory.js: the element as one dependency-free script (global GameDNA_ShapedInventory): shapes and rotation, packing, drag / key / touch input, ghost feedback, swap preview, sort, take-all, use / drop, footprint panels by material, upright icons (image, the game's icon drawer, or bold glyphs), phone tab layout, a built-in 6x8 bitmap font
demo only: the painted-ui (L-06) icon atlas and a demo-kit backdrop; the module itself ships no image
